scanNote:
MUNDARIJA - CHAP BET (2-bet). Sarlavha: 'Contents' - to'q sariq qalin harflar.

Mundarija IKKI BETLIK JADVAL: bu betda uchta ustun - GRAMMAR, VOCABULARY, READING; keyingi betda (3-bet) yana uchta ustun - LISTENING & SPEAKING, COMMUNICATION, WRITING. Ya'ni har unit uchun OLTI ustun bor, ular ikki betga bo'lingan.

Chap chetda vertikal yozuvlar: MODULE 1, MODULE 2, MODULE 3, MODULE 4.

Har unit o'z rangida (pushti, ko'k, binafsha, sariq, yashil - takrorlanadi).

Jadvaldagi qatorlar:
• UNIT 1 People around the World (pp. 6-11)
• UNIT 2 Night and Day (pp. 12-17)
• UNIT 3 Shop till you Drop! (pp. 18-23)
• STORY 1: THE SHARK CALLER - EPISODE 1: THE CURSE (pp. 24-25) [expressing certainty: must, can't, will]
• UNIT 4 Days to Remember (pp. 26-31)
• MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 1 - UNITS 1, 2, 3, 4 (pp. 32-33)
• UNIT 5 Planning Ahead (pp. 34-39)
• UNIT 6 Food, Glorious Food (pp. 40-45)
• STORY 1: THE SHARK CALLER - EPISODE 2: BAD MAGIC (pp. 46-47) [time words; conditionals type 0]
• UNIT 7 Profiles (pp. 48-53)
• UNIT 8 A Brush with Danger (pp. 54-59)
• MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 2 - UNITS 5, 6, 7, 8 (pp. 60-61)
• UNIT 9 A World of Wonders (pp. 62-67)
• STORY 2: THE PYTHON HUNT - EPISODE 1: DO NOT DISTURB (pp. 68-69) [too - enough]
• UNIT 10 Stick to the Rules! (pp. 70-75)
• UNIT 11 Our Precious Planet (pp. 76-81)
• UNIT 12 Holidays with a Difference (pp. 82-87)
• STORY 2: THE PYTHON HUNT - EPISODE 2: FACE-TO-FACE ENCOUNTER (pp. 88-89) [some - any - no]
• MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 3 - UNITS 9, 10, 11, 12 (pp. 90-91)
• UNIT 13 Join in the Fun! (pp. 92-97)
• UNIT 14 Live and Let Live (pp. 98-103)
• UNIT 15 Surf the Net (pp. 104-109)
• STORY 3: ON THE TOP OF THE WORLD (pp. 110-113)
• MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 4 - UNITS 13, 14, 15 (pp. 114-115)
• GRAMMAR REFERENCE SECTION
• IRREGULAR VERBS
• WORD LIST
• PHOTO FILE SECTION

⚠ Beginner kitobida 20 unit va 4 modul edi; bu kitobda 15 UNIT va 4 MODUL bor.

⚠ Beginner'da 'Revision' bo'limlari bor edi; bu yerda ular 'MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT' deb nomlangan.

⚠ Yangilik: uchta HIKOYA (STORY) - komiks shaklida, birinchi ikkitasi ikki qismdan.

exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - MUNDARIJA (2-bet).

  ⚠ Inglizcha: 'Contents'.
  HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA yoziladi.


MUNDARIJA IKKI BETLIK:

  BU BET (2)         Keyingi bet (3)
  ---------------    ------------------
  GRAMMAR            LISTENING & SPEAKING
  VOCABULARY         COMMUNICATION
  READING            WRITING

  ⚠ Ya'ni har unit uchun OLTI ustun bor.
  Ularni birga o'qish kerak: jadvalning
  chap yarmi bu betda, o'ng yarmi
  keyingisida.


KITOBNING TUZILIShI:

  4 MODUL, jami 15 UNIT:

  MODUL 1 - Unit 1, 2, 3, 4
  MODUL 2 - Unit 5, 6, 7, 8
  MODUL 3 - Unit 9, 10, 11, 12
  MODUL 4 - Unit 13, 14, 15

  ⚠ Beginner'da 20 unit bor edi -
  bu kitobda unitlar KAMROQ, lekin
  har biri KATTAROQ (6 betdan).


QO'ShIMChA BO'LIMLAR:

  1) STORY - HIKOYa (komiks)
     Story 1: The Shark Caller
        (Akula chaqiruvchi) - 2 qism
     Story 2: The Python Hunt
        (Piton ovi) - 2 qism
     Story 3: On the Top of the World
        (Dunyoning tepasida)

     ⚠ Har hikoya bir grammatika
     mavzusiga bog'langan:
        Shark Caller 1: must, can't, will
        Shark Caller 2: conditionals type 0
        Python Hunt 1: too - enough
        Python Hunt 2: some - any - no

  2) MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT
     = MODUL O'Z-O'ZINI BAHOLASh
     Har modul oxirida, 2 betdan.

     ⚠ Beginner'da bu 'Revision'
     deb atalgan edi.

  3) GRAMMAR REFERENCE SECTION
     = grammatika ma'lumotnomasi

  4) IRREGULAR VERBS
     = noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati

  5) WORD LIST
     = so'zlar ro'yxati

  6) PHOTO FILE SECTION
     = suratli lug'at bo'limi


⚠ 'CONTENTS' - DIQQAT:

  'content' (birlikda, urg'u OXIRIDA:
  conTENT) = qanoat, mamnun

  'contents' (ko'plikda, urg'u
  BOShIDA: CONtents) = mundarija,
  ichidagi narsalar

  ⚠ Kitobda HAR DOIM 'Contents'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  contents      = mundarija
  a module      = modul
  a unit        = bo'lim, dars
  grammar       = grammatika
  vocabulary    = lug'at
  reading       = o'qish
  a story       = hikoya
  an episode    = qism, epizod
  self-assessment = o'z-o'zini baholash
  a reference   = ma'lumotnoma
  irregular     = noto'g'ri, qoidasiz
  a word list   = so'zlar ro'yxati

points.noteUz:
Grammatika: present simple; takrorlanish
  ravishlari; past simple; used to
Lug'at: kundalik tartib; soatni aytish;
  maktab fanlari
O'qish: orbitadagi kosmonavtlarning kuni

Grammatika: sifatlar tartibi; qiyoslash
Lug'at: do'konlar va xarid; shakllar
O'qish: Parijda xarid; Harrods haqida

⚠ 'Shop till you drop' - so'zma-so'z:
'yiqilguningcha xarid qil'.

points.en: STORY 1: THE SHARK CALLER - EPISODE 1: THE CURSE (pp. 24-25)
points.noteUz:
⚠ Grammatika mavzusi: aniqlik bildirish -
must, can't, will.

⚠ 'a curse' = la'nat.
⚠ 'to call' = chaqirmoq → 'a caller' = chaqiruvchi.

Grammatika: past simple; past continuous;
  sifatlar; ravishlar; gaplarni bog'lash
Lug'at: his-tuyg'ular va munosabat
O'qish: hikoyalar

⚠ 'self-assessment' = o'z-o'zini baholash.
'self' = o'z + 'to assess' = baholamoq.

⚠ Beginner'da bu 'Revision' deb atalgan edi.

Grammatika: will; be going to; present
  continuous (kelasi zamon ma'nosida);
  conditionals type 1; if/when
Lug'at: kasblar; kasb sifatlari; rejalar; ta'til

points.en: STORY 1: THE SHARK CALLER - EPISODE 2: BAD MAGIC (pp. 46-47)

points.noteUz:
Grammatika: past perfect simple;
  past perfect va past continuous farqi
Lug'at: tajribalar; tayyorgarlik; his-tuyg'ular

⚠ 'a brush with danger' - ibora:
'xavfga bir zumga yo'liqish'.

⚠ Har MODUL oxirida keladi, ya'ni har
to'rt unitdan keyin.

Grammatika: majhul nisbat (passive voice)
Lug'at: diqqatga sazovor joylar; muzeylar;
  ixtirochilar
O'qish: Vieliczka tuz koni haqida maqola

points.en: STORY 2: THE PYTHON HUNT - EPISODE 1: DO NOT DISTURB (pp. 68-69)
points.noteUz:
⚠ Grammatika mavzusi: too - enough.

⚠ 'a python' = piton (ilon).
⚠ 'to disturb' = bezovta qilmoq.

Grammatika: nisbiy olmoshlar; joyni tasvirlovchi
  iboralar
Lug'at: dam olish maskanlari; ob-havo; kasblar
O'qish: Alton Towers; Muz mehmonxonasi

points.en: STORY 2: THE PYTHON HUNT - EPISODE 2: FACE-TO-FACE ENCOUNTER (pp. 88-89)
points.noteUz:
⚠ Grammatika mavzusi: some - any - no.

⚠ 'an encounter' = kutilmagan uchrashuv.
⚠ Uchinchi modulning yakuni.

points.en: STORY 3: ON THE TOP OF THE WORLD (pp. 110-113)
points.noteUz:
⚠ Uchinchi hikoya TO'RT betlik - u qismlarga
bo'linmagan.

points.uz: GRAMMATIKA MA'LUMOTNOMASI; NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR; SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI; SURATLI LUG'AT
points.noteUz:

ular kitob oxirida ketma-ket keladi.

'to refer to' = murojaat qilmoq.
